subject.title: Feature Request: Gateway lifecycle hooks (onSubagentComplete, onToolCallThreshold, onTurnComplete)

question: Should OpenClaw sponsor a new workspace/internal lifecycle hook contract for subagent completion, turn completion, and tool-call thresholds, or keep these capabilities on typed plugin hooks only?
rationale: Current main has adjacent plugin hooks but not the requested workspace/internal events; adding them creates a durable API/config/security contract that automation should not choose unilaterally.

options.title: Sponsor a narrow internal-hook contract
options.body: Define a minimal set of core-emitted internal events and payloads, with redaction, timing, timeout, config, and docs requirements before implementation.

options.title: Keep runtime lifecycle control plugin-only
options.body: Close or narrow the workspace-hook request and direct runtime lifecycle/memory integrations to typed plugin hooks such as `agent_end`, `before_tool_call`, and `subagent_ended`.

options.title: Defer to related PRs first
options.body: Wait for the open turn-end/save-hook PRs to resolve, then revisit only the remaining subagent or threshold gaps with current evidence.

recommendation.title: Sponsor a narrow internal-hook contract
recommendation.body: Define a minimal set of core-emitted internal events and payloads, with redaction, timing, timeout, config, and docs requirements before implementation.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent hook/docs history and the timeline mention make this the strongest available owner for the API/product direction choice.
